itemDescriptions.warranty-term: Every siding project we complete is backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty, starting from the date of substantial completion.
itemDescriptions.warranty-transferable: If you sell your home during the 5-year warranty period, the remaining coverage automatically transfers to the new owner, no paperwork, no fees, no hassles.
itemDescriptions.warranty-coverage: We guarantee that your siding is installed according to the manufacturer’s specifications and industry best practices. Our warranty covers workmanship-related issues only, not material defects or failures unrelated to installation.
